bottleneck.description: World's largest excavator hydraulic cylinder supplier (~30% global share) with growing presence in hydraulic pumps, motors, and valves for construction machinery.

dependency.key_customers: Sany, XCMG, Zoomlion, Caterpillar (limited), Komatsu (limited), Volvo CE
dependency.key_suppliers: Steel/alloy mills, sealing technology suppliers, casting foundries

editorial.notes: Hengli broke the Japanese-European duopoly (Kawasaki, Bosch Rexroth, Eaton) in excavator hydraulic cylinders and now serves all major Chinese OEMs (Sany, XCMG, Zoomlion) and key international names. Switching cylinders requires re-engineering for fit/pressure ratings, creating real friction. MEDIUM reflects Hengli's structural cost advantage in cylinders + entrenchment in China construction, but with viable global substitutes (Kawasaki, Bosch Rexroth) the bottleneck is not HIGH.
